name: teams-meetings
description: Extract full speaker-attributed transcripts from Microsoft Teams meetings — both recorded meetings (via a Stream URL) and transcription-only meetings (via guided browser navigation). Works when Stream's own Download transcript button is disabled by permissions. Includes a Transcript Workbench canvas for the GitHub Copilot app: paste a link, pick where the file is saved, and open or reveal it. Requires a Playwright MCP browser and Python 3.
